definitions.gloss: the genuine article; authentic product from its place of origin
definitions.explanation: A product that comes from its recognized place of origin or production, guaranteeing authenticity and quality.

examples.japanese: ⟦これ→これ：00963_kore⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{本場物|ほんばもの}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦チーズ→チーズ：00026_chiizu⟧だ。
examples.english: This is authentic cheese from its place of origin.

examples.japanese: {本場物|ほんばもの}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{味|あじ}→味：00826_aji⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦やはり→やはり：01991_yahari⟧⟦{違|ちが}う→違う：01957_chigau⟧。
examples.english: The taste of the real thing is different after all.

examples.japanese: ⟦イタリア→イタリア：19423_itaria⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{食|た}べた→食べる：00396_taberu⟧{本場物|ほんばもの}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ピザ→ピザ：06769_piza⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦{日本|にほん}→日本：03876_nihon⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{食|た}べる→食べる：00396_taberu⟧もの⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{全|まった}く→全く：02363_mattaku⟧⟦{別物|べつもの}→別物：11880_betsumono⟧だった。
examples.english: The authentic pizza I ate in Italy was completely different from what you get in Japan.

notes:
Composed of ⟦{本場|ほんば}→本場：12867_honba⟧ (the home/birthplace of something, place of origin) + ⟦{物|もの}→物：02259_mono⟧ (thing, product). Emphasizes that the product is from the authentic source, not an imitation or adapted version. Often used for food and traditional crafts.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {本場物|ほんばもの}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{味|あじ}→味：00826_aji⟧: the authentic flavor
- {本場物|ほんばもの}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ワイン→ワイン：01067_wain⟧: wine from its region of origin
- {本場物|ほんばもの}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦こだわる→こだわる：10319_kodawaru⟧: to insist on the genuine article

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{本物|ほんもの}→本物：03628_honmono⟧: the real thing, genuine — emphasizes authenticity vs. fakeness; {本場物|ほんばもの} emphasizes origin
- ⟦{本場|ほんば}→本場：12867_honba⟧: the home/birthplace of something — the place itself, not the product
- ⟦{正真正銘|しょうしんしょうめい}→正真正銘：18651_shoushinshoumei⟧: certified genuine — formal emphasis on absolute authenticity
